text:
sara: Hi — my March 31 stub shows NJ withholding but I moved to PA on Mar 18 and updated Workday on Mar 19. Net is lower than expected, looks like NJ tax stayed. anyone seen this?

tyler: @sara did you file the state change form or just update the address?

sara: Just the address update on Mar 19, relocation form was submitted Mar 25 (late). I thought payroll would pick it up pro-rata.

marcus-payroll: Payroll cut snapshot for 2026-03-31 was taken Mar 20 at 6pm ET; address on file at cutoff was NJ, so withholding used NJ. For midmonth moves we can run an off-cycle to correct state withholding. Need manager approval + proof of move date.

sara: Move date Mar 18. Manager @tyler approves. I attached screenshot to ticket.

people-ops-bot: Created ticket PR-9120 and assigned to marcus-payroll. Off-cycle ETA 2026-04-02 if approvals complete.

marcus-payroll: Preview adjustment: refund NJ state tax 62.11, apply PA withholding prorated 47.90 -> net +14.21. 401k and gross unaffected. If corrected before year-end no W-2c expected.

sara: Thanks — will watch for the off-cycle stub. Also can we add a note to relocation docs about cutoff vs address?

tyler: Good idea, filing doc request.

people-ops-bot: PR-9120 updated: status pending-off-cycle.
